context: Request: has the firm ever set up a fund using an American, deal-by-deal waterfall (for advice to a new fund client). Rubric: one criterion, a negative answer that separates drafts, abandoned terms and a single-asset co-invest vehicle from an adopted precedent; no matter numbers named.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Attempt 2: saves the full file list, counts files and folders and prints every path (about 793K characters).

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: declared: List files in the document store (attempt 3). Per-matter file counts and a path regex for request words, capped at 240 lines; six candidate matters. The review flags the cap and the missing text search; its label note names this stage.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: declared: new: Full-text scan for … terms. A store-wide extraction script times out; a rerun limited to eight path-hit matters reports 244 hit files. The review flags the hand-picked set and suggests a batched scan step.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: declared: new: Batched full-store … scan (the step the review suggested). The first 70 matters finish; a loop over the remaining ranges times out after one batch.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads the openings of six documents from six candidates (draft agreements and markups, structuring memos, a carry agreement), extracts distribution-clause snippets, lists one matter and reads an executed co-invest agreement at several offsets. The review flags nine surfaced matters never opened; its label note names the listing-picked reading stage.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Attempt 2: reads one document from each of six matters the review named; the review flags three surfaced matters still unopened.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists all files of four matters the review named.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes that no adopted precedent was found, separating drafts and markups from executed documents. The review warns the negative answer may exclude qualifying matters.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Re-reads the response; a path check fails on a missing path and is rerun; spot-checks two sources.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Attempt 2: prints the response and extracts the distribution section of the executed co-invest agreement.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

divergence: All three runs pass with the same procedure: a store inventory, store-wide text-extraction scans (timeouts handled by narrowing or sharding), screening reads of the partnership agreements, structuring memos and markups of the matters the scans surfaced, then a negative answer that separates drafts, a replaced per-deal draft and a single-asset co-invest vehicle from an adopted precedent. Reviews in every run kept flagging dozens of surfaced matters never opened and drafts read instead of executed papers; the agents widened screening in response but none changed the conclusion. T2 declared four new stages (two the reviewer suggested), all of which fit existing stages.
